title: Source text masking
responsibility: Replaces comments and optional literal contents with spaces while retaining offsets, line breaks and template expressions for source analysis.

inputs.name: maskSource.code
inputs.description: Source text to scan using JavaScript-like comment, string, template and regular-expression rules.

inputs.name: maskSource.options
inputs.description: Optional strings flag, default true, controlling whether literal contents are blanked as well as comments.

outputs.name: maskSource
outputs.description: Same-length text with comments blanked, newlines preserved, literal delimiters retained and template interpolation code still visible. With strings false, literal contents remain.
